mostWorthwhile.text: Following the cold clouds through the hot flow to their eventual return was most worthwhile: it showed that outward motion need not mean escape.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final move to the outer reaches was fairly predictable once the clouds were carried outward, though it resolved their fate.

surprise.text: The narrow jet inflated a much wider hot cavity, and dense cloud interiors remained cold within the resulting flow.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt particularly arbitrary; each followed the visible physical situation.
